title: 演示成功不等于测试齐全
premise: 评审时段确定，Hannah报告尚缺的异常路径测试。
listeningTask: 识别异常游标、空页和取消操作三项测试缺口。

lines.en: There's a test coverage gap around pagination. Empty pages and repeated cursors aren't covered.
lines.zh: 分页存在测试缺口，空页和重复游标未覆盖。

lines.en: I'm on it with repeated cursor detection. A repeated token must stop pagination safely.
lines.zh: 重复游标检测我来做，重复令牌必须安全停止分页。

lines.en: An empty page can still have continuation. Don't automatically treat it as completion.
lines.zh: 空页仍可能带续页标识，不能自动当作结束。

lines.en: Just to confirm, the API allows that, right? I'll ask its owner for an example.
lines.zh: 确认一下，接口允许这种情况，对吧？我找负责人要例子。

lines.en: Okay, one action item per missing case. Maybe cancellation can pair with parser cleanup.
lines.zh: 好，每个缺口单列任务，取消操作可能与解析器释放资源一起做。

lines.en: We can't rule that out without tests. A successful demo doesn't exercise cancellation behavior.
lines.zh: 没测试就不能排除问题，演示成功没覆盖取消行为。

lines.en: I'll check resource ownership during review. Close the response when the user interrupts.
lines.zh: 评审时检查资源所有权，用户中断要关闭响应。

lines.en: A new paging framework would take longer. Let's park that and test our current loop.
lines.zh: 新分页框架会耗时更多，先放下，测试当前循环。

lines.en: I'll log the unresolved contract question separately. That shouldn't hide the known local gaps.
lines.zh: 未决契约问题单独记录，不能遮住已知本地缺口。

lines.en: Agreed, report test evidence at day's end. No claim of complete coverage until then.
lines.zh: 同意，日终报告测试证据，在那之前不宣称覆盖完整。
